extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, inventors, patent attorneys, and PRH stakeholders interested in fast-track prosecution of green-technology inventions in Finland
extracted.subtask_short: fast-track patent prosecution for green inventions
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on requesting and managing Finland's PRH fast-track examination for green-technology patent applications, plus associated quality management and PCT/PPH handling. Covers timelines, eligibility, quality control, examiner training, and harmonisation with EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fast Track request timing and outcome targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Must be requested at the same time as the application is filed. Fast track is PRH's premium examination service when the applicant requires a positive outcome within the priority year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office Action 1 (OA1) within 3 months after all documents are in order; OA2 within 2 months from the reply to OA1. Enables at least two Office Actions within the priority year. Does not cost extra but requests may be discarded due to overload. Can be complemented with consultation.

rubrics_metrics.name: National application standard and fast-track timeline comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard national procedure: OA1 in 7 months from filing date; OA2 and further office actions within a year of applicant’s reply. Fast track: accelerated timelines as above.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All parts of the application and communications can be in Finnish, Swedish or English (applicant free to choose). Oppositions and appeals only in Finnish or Swedish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fast Track request acceptance constraints and historical pitfalls
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational constraints identified from earlier process versions which affected fast-track reliability and resource planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Old process was rigid; inventors’ transfer rights documents often delayed => drop to normal procedure after 1 month delay. Fast Track requests previously had to be accepted within 1 month from filing which caused resource planning difficulties. During summer OA2 delivery time varied. Process updated in 2020 to address these issues; requests may still be discarded due to overload.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT handling and search/examination standards at PRH
rubrics_metrics.description: PRH acts as an international PCT authority (ISA/IPEA). Search is executed with the same tools and databases as the European Patent Office (EPO). PRH also searches/examines non-technical features and unclear claims to cover jurisdictional differences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different examiners handle PCT and national priority applications, resulting in a second search and opinion for quality and coverage. Consulting examiner is mandatory in all PCT applications (see Quality Control Processes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) relationship requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: For PPH procedure, Application 1 and Application 2 must have a relationship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of acceptable relationships: Application 2 may claim priority from Application 1, or Application 2 may be a PCT application in the national phase of Application 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Management System (QMS) application and standards
rubrics_metrics.description: QMS is applied to key processes in Patents and Trademarks area including handling of patent applications (national, PCT, utility models), trademarks and key support processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delivery time is a part of quality but being fast is not enough. QMS established according to ISO 9001 (2015) standard. QMS supports process management, training, ICT, and continuous improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-level quality control and checks before and after Office Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality control is performed at multiple levels in the examination workflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent examiner performs search and examination and drafts an Office Action. Principal patent examiner checks the quality. Head of Division checks the quality. Preventive actions: quality control prior to sending out OA. Corrective actions: quality control after sending out OA. Consulting examiner is mandatory in all PCT applications. Internal guidelines, training, and continuous evaluation of quality indicators support these checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Assurance Group (QAG) sampling and assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated QA group of senior examiners measures the quality level of searches and examinations based on quality assessment criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: QAG consists of 10–12 senior examiners (part-time). They analyse whether the examiner has followed given quality criteria, standards, and guidelines. They perform random sampling of cases and produce quality reports to inform improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner training, supervision and authorization
rubrics_metrics.description: New examiners undergo a structured training and supervision program prior to independent work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training of new examiners takes about 18 months. During this time their work is supervised by a tutor (senior patent examiner). After training they are interviewed and authorized to work independently. There is basic training, tutoring for newcomers, and continuous training for all examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harmonisation of search activities with EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: PRH cooperates with the EPO to harmonise search activities and align practices and quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special agreement: EPO may carry out searches for harmonisation purposes (shall not exceed 50 per year). EPO remains responsible for carrying out the search under PCT. 50% of the international search fee is transferred to PRH. Participation has shown PRH and EPO quality at the same level and internal guidelines well harmonised with EPO practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous development inputs and customer-centred improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Process improvement is driven by internal and external inputs and feedback loops.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sources include customer feedback via online forms, customer relations management (KAMs), customer satisfaction surveys, discussion panels with patent attorneys, complaints, external audits, appeal court decisions, inputs from other patent offices, internal quality control reports, internal audits, quality and performance indicators, QA group findings, and ideas/best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Philosophy for supporting green technology prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level principles guiding how PRH supports green-technology applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principles stated: (1) One size does not fit all but alternatives are needed; (2) Green tech is about thinking local and acting global; (3) Mistakes are expensive but cannot be totally eliminated. These inform offering alternative procedures (like fast track) and balancing speed vs quality.
